packages.name: bash
cleanup: Removing this package leaves ~/.bashrc absent; migration backups remain under the Dotfiles XDG state backup tree

packages.name: tmux
packages.description: Complete Omarchy-based tmux configuration and private session starter
validators: bash -c 'socket_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dotfiles-tmux-validator.XXXXXX") || exit 1; socket=$socket_dir/socket; cleanup() { TMUX= tmux -S "$socket" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf -- "$socket_dir"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; TMUX= tmux -S "$socket" -f /dev/null new-session -d -s dotfiles-validator \; source-file "$HOME/.config/tmux/tmux.conf"'
cleanup: Arch packages tmux, fzf, and less remain installed
The tmux server, sessions, panes, logs, and other runtime state are not removed
Run omarchy refresh tmux after removal to restore the Omarchy baseline

packages.name: starship
validators: bash -c 'work=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dotfiles-starship-validator.XXXXXX") || exit 1; diagnostics=$work/stderr; cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$work"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; export STARSHIP_CONFIG=$HOME/.config/starship.toml; export STARSHIP_CACHE=$work/cache; export STARSHIP_SESSION_KEY=dotfiles-starship-validation; mkdir -p -- "$STARSHIP_CACHE" || exit 1; if ! starship print-config >/dev/null 2>"$diagnostics"; then cat -- "$diagnostics" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [[ -s $diagnostics ]]; then cat -- "$diagnostics" >&2; exit 1; fi'
cleanup: Starship cache and state are not removed
Migration backups remain under the Dotfiles XDG state backup tree
Optional post-removal baseline restoration command (reported only, not run): omarchy refresh config starship.toml
